_comment: App Builder workstream C1 (build platform): components of the builder image and the registry, folded by H into licenses/components.tsv, THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md and sbom.cdx.json. The builder image's Go modules are judged on the built bytes by scripts/check-builder-sbom.mjs; this fragment inventories what that SBOM cannot see (the C code) and the pinned upstream components.

components.name: opencontainers/runc
components.note: built from source without the seccomp tag (no libseccomp), static against musl (commit 46365c62967c76a765a5e347f48f0c7b3b571fe9)

components.name: shadow-maint/shadow (newuidmap, newgidmap)
components.note: only newuidmap/newgidmap, static against musl; rootlesskit writes its id map through them

components.name: google/go-containerregistry (crane)
components.note: built from source; the push step

components.name: kubernetes-sigs/security-profiles-operator
components.note: dev only, the approved seccomp fallback (scripts/spo/install.sh)

attributions: musl libc (static, in runc/newuidmap/newgidmap) - MIT - https://musl.libc.org
